scenario_library.title: Churn Support Surge
scenario_library.description: Simulates rising support burden and engagement decline to show churn intervention prioritization.

scenario_library.title: Incrementality Negative Lift
scenario_library.description: Introduces campaigns with weaker treated conversion outcomes to demonstrate scale/pause/retest decisions.

scenario_library.title: MMM Budget Rebalance
scenario_library.description: Shifts channel spend mix so technical users can inspect response changes and optimization recommendations.

scenario_library.title: NBA DQ Failure Demo
scenario_library.description: For governance walkthroughs: injects data-quality gate failure.

scenario_library.title: NBA High-Risk Save
scenario_library.description: Pushes risk scores upward and contact pressure upward to explain retention rescue actioning.

platform_flow.label: Data Sources
platform_flow.business_summary: Collects first-party customer and campaign signals required for decisions.
platform_flow.technical_summary: Contract-aware source generation and connector abstraction for repeatable ingestion.

platform_flow.label: Ingestion + Event Bus
platform_flow.business_summary: Creates a reliable event trail so decisions are explainable and replayable.
platform_flow.technical_summary: Canonical topic naming, append-only events, and deterministic artifact persistence.

platform_flow.label: Raw Storage + Curated Warehouse
platform_flow.business_summary: Preserves immutable evidence and creates analytics-ready curated data.
platform_flow.technical_summary: Stores raw event logs and curated joins in JSON/JSONL with warehouse mirroring options.

platform_flow.label: Identity Resolution + Customer 360
platform_flow.business_summary: Unifies customer records so targeting and measurement use a single customer truth.
platform_flow.technical_summary: Deterministic unified IDs and household keys for person-level use cases.

platform_flow.label: Feature Layer
platform_flow.business_summary: Transforms raw behavior into measurable business signals used by models.
platform_flow.technical_summary: Use-case-specific feature projections persisted as model-ready rows.

platform_flow.label: Model Layer (MMM, Incrementality, Attribution, Experimentation)
platform_flow.business_summary: Generates recommendations and causal insights to optimize marketing outcomes.
platform_flow.technical_summary: Pluggable model registry validates outputs against contract fields.

oss_profile: OSS data sinks for all use cases

platform_flow.label: Serving + Activation
platform_flow.business_summary: Turns model output into actions that campaign systems can execute.
platform_flow.technical_summary: Use-case payload adapters map model rows into destination contracts.

platform_flow.label: Monitoring + Governance
downstream: Feedback to Data Sources and Model Layer
platform_flow.business_summary: Maintains trust through validation gates, alerts, and deployment readiness checks.
platform_flow.technical_summary: Contract coverage checks, gate results, and run-status reporting.
